query: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])
